notes: P0-5a data reading and validation (plan 4.5 S1-S4, S9, S10). Universal corrections follow decisions A3/Q9 (P6-24) and A5 (P6-02, P6-03, P6-04); P6-01 and the validation/unit contracts are pure software fixes (plan 4.5 dual-track).

The registry-backed repairs (P6-02/P6-03/P6-04) act only on objects whose sha256 is verified against gridform_core/data/validation/known_data_objects_v1.json; the shipped VALUE 101 packs carry constant, identical boundary series and no registry object, so their trajectories are unchanged.

P0-5b corrected-profile data science (plan 4.5 S5-S8, S11, S12; decisions Q15, A1 and the nuclear/hydro row): weather v2 time conventions, literature VRE loss factors (no statistical calibration), nuclear and natural-flow hydro availability (reference values PENDING AUTHOR REVIEW), raw boundary prices, and the kernel receiving the same site/firm arrays as the canonical adapter. The weather cache key is a universal software fix.

advisory.title: Interconnector series read as period numbers
advisory.summary: Before P0-5a a declared csv_column was ignored: R029 interconnector prices and flows were read as the period index (0..17519), so imports, prices, costs and emissions of this Run are invalid.

corrections.description: A binding's declared csv_column (and csv_header) is read in every reading mode; an implicitly selected integer index column is refused (GF_DATA_INDEX_COLUMN).

advisory.title: Belgium price read as half-hourly GBP
advisory.summary: Before P0-5a the GBP1 Belgium price (hourly EUR/MWh) was read as half-hourly GBP/MWh by the canonical adapter and as zero by the retained kernel.

corrections.description: The verified GBP1 Belgium_price.csv is read from its EUR column, divided by the documented 1.1 EUR/GBP (R029 approved_r03 basis) and expanded hour -> two half-hours, in both profiles (decision A5).

advisory.title: Belgium and Netherlands flows swapped
advisory.summary: Before P0-5a the GBP1 Belgium role carried the BritNed (Netherlands) flow and vice versa, and the retained kernel fed three Connection objects with another country's files.

corrections.description: Interconnector flow files are assigned by NESO line identity (BRITNED_FLOW -> netherlands, NEMO_FLOW -> belgium ...), and every kernel Connection receives its own country's series, in both profiles (decision A5; the kernel wiring is part of P6-03).

advisory.title: Demand off the UTC clock after 2022-10-30
advisory.summary: Before P0-5a GBP1 demand and forecast were read in source row order; from 2022-10-30 they ran 2 periods off the UTC clock.

corrections.description: The verified GBP1 demand files are put on the UTC clock with the R029 audit rule (2022-10-30 duplicates dropped, four named gaps interpolated), in both profiles (decision A5). The doctoral forecast keeps its frozen one-period lead (P6-05 is corrected only).

advisory.title: Interconnector series stretched twice in the retained kernel
advisory.summary: Before P0-5a the retained kernel served each interconnector row for two periods (IterLimit_new), so a full year used only January to early July boundary data.

corrections.description: The retained kernel receives the interconnector series from the shared reader and assigns them period by period on the run clock (src[p]), in both profiles.

Data-pack validation has structural (decides valid), chronology and plausibility layers and a per-profile eligibility; market slots carry units; CSV mapping declares column, header, interval and EUR conversion.

deviation_signature.doctoral: legacy-v1 reader: an undeclared header is assumed (the first value of a headerless file is lost)

corrections.description: declared-v2 reading: an undeclared header is inferred (only a wholly non-numeric first row), several numeric columns are ambiguous (strict raises GF_DATA_AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN).

deviation_signature.doctoral: legacy clock: a half-hour profile longer than the window is expanded as hourly

corrections.description: The clock takes the resolution from interval_minutes (or an hourly length 8760/8784) before truncating, removes 29 February from a leap year and wraps a short series only when cyclic.

deviation_signature.doctoral: chronology and plausibility findings are warnings; registry-identified defects are repaired and recorded

corrections.description: Registry-identified data defects and chronology findings of non-workspace packs, and plausibility failures of scientific reference packs, make a pack ineligible for the profile (preflight error).

advisory.title: Solar served one hour late
advisory.summary: Runs made before P0-5b (and doctoral runs) serve the ERA5 accumulated irradiance of the hour ending at h to the hour starting at h, so solar output is about one hour late (London centroid 12.97 instead of 11.97 UTC).

deviation_signature.doctoral: weather v1: period t takes source hour t//2 for accumulations and instants alike

corrections.description: Weather v2: an accumulated field (GRIB stepType accum, or a declared time_convention) stamped at the end of its hour gives period t the hour t//2+1; an instantaneous field the timestamp nearest the period midpoint, (t+1)//2. Applied to the canonical adapter and, through the kernel injection, to the retained kernel.

advisory.title: Wind and solar without losses
advisory.summary: Runs made before P0-5b (and doctoral runs) use the free-stream single-turbine power curve and GHI/1 kW m-2 without wake, availability, electrical losses or a PV performance ratio; GBP1 onshore CF is about 0.42-0.45 and offshore about 0.60.

deviation_signature.doctoral: no loss factor: power-curve CF and ssrd/3.6e6 are dispatched as available

corrections.description: Literature loss factors after the ERA5 -> power-curve conversion (onshore 0.90307, offshore 0.814968, solar PR 0.83; data/weather/value_uk_vre_loss_factors_v1.json, accepted by the author in A9). No calibration to statistical load factors (Q15).

advisory.title: Nuclear and natural-flow hydro always available
advisory.summary: Runs made before P0-5b (and doctoral runs) dispatch nuclear and natural-flow hydro at availability 1.0 (hydro up to about 17.5 TWh/a against 5-6 TWh actual) and retire a nuclear station for whole years only.

corrections.description: Nuclear station load factors (PRIS 2019-2024, rescaled to the model capacity) with month-exact generation end, natural-flow hydro annual load factor x monthly shape (data/nuclear/value_uk_firm_availability_v1.json; values reviewed by the author in A14, refined by p05.nuclear-generation-end-month and p05.hydro-dukes-load-factor).

advisory.title: Heysham 2 and Torness retire for the whole of 2030
advisory.summary: Corrected runs made before decision A10 keep Heysham 2 and Torness available for all of 2030 because the station policy names only the year; their announced generation end is March 2030.

corrections.description: A station whose policy record names only the year of generation end takes the month from generation_end_month_overrides of data/nuclear/value_uk_firm_availability_v1.json (Heysham 2 and Torness: 2030-03, reference statistics 1.6), so it is zero from period 4320 of 2030 like Heysham 1 and Hartlepool.

advisory.title: GBP1 public2 nuclear as one aggregate asset
advisory.summary: Corrected runs on GBP1 public2 made before decision A16-7 treat nuclear as one aggregate asset at the national fallback load factor 0.723 with whole-year retirement, instead of the declared EDF station fleet with station load factors and month-exact generation ends.

deviation_signature.doctoral: GBP1 public2 is not a doctoral pack; the station fleet stays keyed on GBP1 public1 only

corrections.description: GBP1 public2 (the local revision of GBP1 public1, value-uk-open-data-pack-public2) joins the VALUE-UK nuclear station policy of GBP1 public1 (data/nuclear/value_uk_nuclear_policy_v1.json: five EDF stations with declared retirements, Hinkley Point C and Sizewell C as exogenous pipeline projects, no endogenous nuclear investment) instead of one aggregate Nuclear asset at the national fallback load factor, so p05.firm-availability derates each station by its own load factor and p05.nuclear-generation-end-month retires it by month.

advisory.title: Natural-flow hydro on the provisional P0-5b values
advisory.summary: Corrected runs made before decision A14 derate natural-flow hydro with the provisional 2023 load factor 0.334 and a flat monthly shape instead of the DUKES 2019-2024 mean 0.3487 with the quarterly-derived seasonal shape.

corrections.description: Natural-flow hydro availability = 0.3487 (DUKES 6.3 standard basis, 2019-2024 mean) x the stepped monthly shape [1.3851 x3, 0.6582 x3, 0.6776 x3, 1.2791 x3] from Energy Trends 6.1 quarters (data/nuclear/value_uk_firm_availability_v1.json, author-reviewed in A14).

advisory.title: Solar on the horizontal plane
advisory.summary: Runs made before decision A13 (and doctoral runs) take solar output from horizontal irradiance (GHI/1 kW m-2, times PR 0.83 for corrected runs) without the gain of a tilted module plane; the PV performance ratio is defined on plane-of-array irradiance, so corrected solar output was low.

deviation_signature.doctoral: solar availability is ssrd/3.6e6 on the horizontal plane (no decomposition, no transposition)

corrections.description: Per period, ERA5 horizontal irradiance is split into diffuse and beam (Erbs 1982) and transposed (Hay-Davies 1980, albedo 0.2) onto a south-facing plane at the Jacobson & Jadhav (2018) optimal tilt for the site latitude, with Spencer (1971) solar geometry at the period midpoint; the PV performance ratio 0.83 then applies (data/weather/value_uk_vre_loss_factors_v1.json, solar_plane_of_array; model choices approved by the author in A16-6).

deviation_signature.doctoral: the canonical interconnector offer price is truncated at 0 outside the doctoral-national alignment

corrections.description: Interconnector import offers and export prices of the canonical adapter keep negative source prices (plan 4.5 point 7).
The retained kernel's process weather cache is keyed by the real paths, sizes and modification times of its weather files, so a later run in the same process on other weather never reuses it.
